title: App State Move-In 2026: Student Housing Guide for Parents
excerpt: App State move-in week is one of the most energizing times of year in Boone — and for parents writing rent checks, it can also be the most eye-opening. Here's what the student housing market looks like right now, and why some families are rethinking renting altogether.
